result.summary: Overall the page renders cleanly. The one visible defect is vertical misalignment among the cards in the 'Fastest near you' carousel. The clipped chip and carousel item at the right edge and the partially visible card at the bottom are intentional and were not reported.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the cards are not top-aligned. 'Smash Bros Burgers' starts about 27px lower than 'Green Bowl Poké', so its image and title sit at different heights, which looks uneven.
issues.suggestion: Top-align the carousel items and give the image containers a fixed height and consistent vertical offset so the titles and delivery fees line up across cards.
